integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The accounts Zenbree sends from on your behalf. They are needed for campaigns; building lists needs nothing connected.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.description: Connect your LinkedIn profile to send invitations and messages from campaigns.
linkedin.statusError: We can't read the connection status right now.
linkedin.riskDefault: LinkedIn's terms do not allow automation: LinkedIn may restrict or suspend your account. To reduce the risk we send with daily caps per account, random gaps between actions and only during working hours. Your password stays with the connection provider; we don't store it.
linkedin.riskAccept: I have read this and accept the risk to my LinkedIn account.
linkedin.useCredentials: Sign in with email and password
linkedin.credentialsPurpose: We use the login only to connect the profile: it is forwarded to the provider and not stored.
linkedin.codeHint: LinkedIn asked for a verification: enter the code you received or approve the sign-in in the app.

mailbox.disconnectBullet2: We revoke Google access automatically; for Microsoft, also remove Zenbree from the apps with access to your Microsoft account
mailbox.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect the mailbox. Please try again.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.description: Connect your HubSpot portal: before every send we check the CRM and skip anyone who is already a customer, has an open deal, unsubscribed, or was contacted by your team in the last 30 days. We change nothing in HubSpot until you turn on writing below.
hubspot.notConfigured: Not available on this server yet.
hubspot.statusError: We can't read your HubSpot connection right now.

hubspot.failedNotice: HubSpot could not be connected. Please try again.

hubspot.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect HubSpot. Please try again.

writeBack.label: Write to HubSpot
writeBack.help: Zenbree creates in HubSpot the contact, and its company, of every person it writes to from the moment you turn this on. On the contact's timeline it logs every email and LinkedIn message sent and every reply received. It never overwrites data that is already there and assigns no owner.
writeBack.needsPermission: Writing to HubSpot needs one more permission. Reconnect the portal and, on HubSpot's screen, tick the optional permissions to create and edit contacts and companies: they are not selected by default. Campaigns keep checking HubSpot as they do now.
writeBack.noCompanies: The companies permission is missing: for now only contacts will be written. To add companies too, reconnect and tick that permission on HubSpot's screen.
writeBack.reconnectFailed: Could not start the connection. Please try again.
writeBack.failed: Could not save your choice. Please try again.

timeline.title: Activity from other tools
timeline.help: Emails, replies and unsubscribes that a tool such as Instantly handles for the people Zenbree found are logged on the contact's HubSpot timeline, at their original time. Adding someone to a campaign is never logged as a sent email.
timeline.empty: Nothing yet. Events appear here as they arrive.
timeline.logged: {n, plural, one {# event logged} other {{n, number, credits} events logged}}
timeline.pending: {n, plural, one {# event waiting} other {{n, number, credits} events waiting}}
timeline.uncertainHint: Log again may add a second note on the contact. Mark as logged adds nothing, so the note may be missing.
timeline.retriedToast: {n, plural, one {# event will be written again.} other {{n, number, credits} events will be written again.}}
timeline.markedToast: {n, plural, one {# event marked as logged.} other {{n, number, credits} events marked as logged.}}
timeline.failed: Could not save your choice. Please try again.

codes.ownerLeft: {count, plural, one {# event waits} other {{count, number, credits} events wait}} because the teammate who sent these people to the tool is no longer in the organization. Nothing to do: they are written if that teammate comes back.
codes.grantRevoked: {count, plural, one {# event waits} other {{count, number, credits} events wait}} because HubSpot is not connected or no longer lets Zenbree create contacts. Reconnect HubSpot and tick the permissions on its screen: they are then written.
codes.held: {count, plural, one {# event waits} other {{count, number, credits} events wait}} because the person is on hold: Zenbree checks HubSpot first (open deal, customer, recent contact). They are written when the hold ends.
codes.vendorDisabled: {count, plural, one {# event waits} other {{count, number, credits} events wait}} because writing to HubSpot is paused on this server. It resumes when it is switched back on.
codes.noOwner: {count, plural, one {# event was skipped} other {{count, number, credits} events were skipped}} because nobody sent the person to the tool, so no HubSpot account can write it.
codes.outsideWriteBack: {count, plural, one {# event was skipped} other {{count, number, credits} events were skipped}} because it happened before you turned on writing to HubSpot, or while the switch was off.
codes.duplicate: {count, plural, one {# event was skipped} other {{count, number, credits} events were skipped}} because the same event is already on the timeline.
codes.nativeDuplicate: {count, plural, one {# event was skipped} other {{count, number, credits} events were skipped}} because Zenbree already logged the same email from its own campaign.
codes.refused: {count, plural, one {# event failed} other {{count, number, credits} events failed}} because HubSpot refused the activity after 5 tries. Check the permissions of the connection, then retry.
codes.contactRefused: {count, plural, one {# event failed} other {{count, number, credits} events failed}} because HubSpot refused to create or update the contact after 5 tries. Check the permissions of the connection, then retry.
codes.answerLost: {count, plural, one {# unsubscribe note is unsure} other {{count, number, credits} unsubscribe notes are unsure}}: HubSpot did not answer and a note leaves no trace to check.
codes.unknown: {count, plural, one {# event has a status this page does not know} other {{count, number, credits} events have a status this page does not know}}.

instantly.name: Instantly
instantly.description: Add qualified people to an Instantly campaign. Instantly sends the emails, not Zenbree.
instantly.notConfigured: Instantly is not available on this server.
instantly.statusError: Could not read the Instantly status.
instantly.errorHint: Instantly refused the saved key. Connect again with a new key.
instantly.keyHint: Create it in Instantly under Settings, API keys, with all access, or at least with access to the workspace, campaigns, leads (also to delete them), emails and webhooks. Zenbree stores it encrypted and never shows it again. To show the Instantly mailboxes on the Senders page, also give it accounts:read (optional).
instantly.disconnectDescription: Zenbree deletes the key. The people already added stay in Instantly and their results stay here.
instantly.heldNote: Reconnect Instantly to settle these people: until then they wait.

mode.live: Campaign events arrive as Instantly sends them.
mode.polled: Campaign events arrive within a few minutes: Zenbree checks Instantly on a schedule.
mode.paused: Instantly is switched off for now: Zenbree reads no campaign events.

refusal.plan: Your Instantly plan has no webhooks, so events are not instant.
refusal.scope: The API key may not create webhooks, so events are not instant. Use a key with all access to change this.
refusal.refused: Instantly refused the webhook, so events are not instant. Zenbree asks again each day.
refusal.no_public_url: This server cannot receive webhooks, so events are not instant.

sync.completeUntil: Sends, replies, bounces and unsubscribes are complete up to {ago}.
sync.firstPass: Zenbree has not read every campaign event yet.
sync.failingReason: Instantly did not answer. Zenbree tries again soon.
sync.emailsRefused: The API key may not read emails. Zenbree records bounces, unsubscribes and labels, and the sends and replies the webhook reports, but it cannot tell a person from an autoresponder, so a reply never stops a lead. Use a key with all access to change this.
sync.replySorting: A reply is sorted (person or autoresponder) within a few minutes.

later.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME: Instantly did not answer in time.
later.RATE_LIMITED: Instantly asked Zenbree to slow down.
later.LEAD_NOT_SETTLED: Instantly does not list this person in the campaign yet.
later.other: The last try did not go through.

failed.UNREACHABLE: Instantly could not be reached, try after try, so the person is still in the campaign. Retry the stop, or remove them in Instantly and confirm here.
failed.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME: Instantly did not answer in time, try after try, so Zenbree does not know if it removed the person. Retry the stop, or check in Instantly and confirm here.
failed.RATE_LIMITED: Instantly kept limiting requests, so the stop did not go through. Retry it, or remove the person in Instantly and confirm here.
failed.REJECTED: Instantly refused to remove this person. Remove them in Instantly, then confirm here.
failed.NOT_FOUND: Instantly no longer has this person's campaign. Check in Instantly that they get no more emails, then confirm here.
